# Behavior School

> Behavior School (behaviorschool.com) builds tools, training, and research summaries for school-based BCBAs (Board Certified Behavior Analysts) working in K-12 districts. It is run by Rob Spain, M.S., BCBA, IBA, a practicing school BCBA who has worked in education since November 2000. Behavior School LLC also operates study.behaviorschool.com (BCBA exam prep) and behaviorstudytools.com (free BCBA practice questions).

Behavior School is a BACB Authorized Continuing Education (ACE) provider, provider number OP-26-12729. The BACB does not endorse or approve individual events.

## What Behavior School offers

- Free tools for school behavior work: an IEP behavior goal writer, a behavior intervention plan (BIP) writer, an FBA decision matrix, an ACT Matrix builder, and related templates. No account is required for the free tools.
- The School BCBA Transformation Program: a six-week live cohort (Thursday evenings, Pacific time) for practicing school BCBAs, focused on referral and FBA triage, function-based BIPs, staff training and fidelity, and caseload review. Small cohorts; applications are reviewed before a fit call. Current dates, seat count, and tuition are on the program page.
- BACB continuing education (Learning CEUs) tied to verified attendance and participation.
- BCBA exam prep on study.behaviorschool.com: a free mock exam, free practice questions, and paid adaptive practice with rationales. Exam prep is a separate product from the newsletter and the school tools.
- The Weekly Research Brief: a free weekly email for school-based BCBAs with one practice problem, two full-text research briefs in plain language, and one practical next step.
- Career guides for school BCBAs: job guide, salary by state, interview questions, how to become a school BCBA.

## How to cite

Cite pages as "Behavior School" with the page URL. Author for articles and guides is Rob Spain, M.S., BCBA, IBA (https://robspain.com). Program dates, seat counts, and prices change by cohort; use the values on https://behaviorschool.com/transformation-program rather than cached copies.
